title: Student App and Journey Integration
problemSolved: Students navigate a fragmented digital estate with no single useful place to start their day, and King’s does not yet have a coherent student-facing product and reusable app platform through which essential information, services and deeper digital journeys can be brought together.
whatChanges: King’s establishes the Student Experience Hub as the common digital starting point for students: a September 2027 first release aggregates priority information and service entry points from King’s Edge, timetabling, KEATS and Ask King’s, while shared app and integration foundations support progressively deeper journeys over time.
